# source: https://handbook.fide.com/chapter/C05Annex1 (FIDE Handbook C.05 Annex 1: Details of Berger Table; fetched 2026-11-01)
# rule text: "Where there is an odd number of players, the highest number counts as a bye." (i.e. 3 -> table 3/4, player 4 = bye; 5 -> table 5/6, player 6 = bye; etc.)
# rule text: "For a double-round tournament it is recommended to reverse the order of the last two rounds of the first cycle. This is to avoid three consecutive games with the same colour."
# pairs a-b: a has White, b has Black, as printed. Second cycle of a double round-robin: colours reversed (FIDE page does not state it; see notes.md).
# one deviation from print: 13/14 Rd 10 is printed '2-9. 3-8' (stray full stop); written here as '2-9, 3-8' -> '2-9 3-8'
# format: '## N' = table for N-1 or N players (N even); 'R<k>: a-b c-d ...'
